description: This Java class 'BOMTree' models an in-memory representation of a Bill of Materials (BOM) for manufacturing products, supporting tree traversal, explosion, implosion, and manufacturing order creation.

classes.name: BOMTree
classes.description: Represents a bill of materials as a tree structure, supporting operations like explosion, implosion, configuration check, and manufacturing order creation.

methods.name: BOMTree
methods.description: Constructor that initializes BOMTree by reading downward (explosion) for a given productId.

methods.name: BOMTree
methods.description: Constructor that initializes BOMTree for specified traversal type (explosion, implosion, etc.) for a productId.

methods.name: getInputProduct
methods.description: Returns the input product's GenericValue.

methods.name: manufacturedAsProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the product association indicating if the product is manufactured as a different product.

methods.name: hasBom
methods.description: Checks if a product has an associated bill of materials for a given date.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the BOM tree is fully configured (no virtual nodes).

methods.name: getRootQuantity
methods.description: Returns the root quantity of the BOM.

methods.name: setRootQuantity
methods.description: Sets the root quantity of the BOM.

methods.name: getRootAmount
methods.description: Returns the root amount.

methods.name: setRootAmount
methods.description: Sets the root amount.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root BOMNode.

methods.name: getInDate
methods.description: Returns the date for BOM validity.

methods.name: getBomTypeId
methods.description: Returns the BOM type ID.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the BOM tree structure into a StringBuffer for debugging.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints BOM nodes into a list with specified initial depth.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints BOM nodes into a list with initial depth and option to exclude WIP nodes.

methods.name: sumQuantities
methods.description: Summarizes quantities of all products in the BOM tree into a map.

methods.name: getAllProductsId
methods.description: Returns a list of all product IDs contained in the BOM tree.

methods.name: createManufacturingOrders
methods.description: Creates manufacturing orders for all nodes that need manufacturing, based on the BOM tree.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Retrieves products contained in packages within the BOM tree.
